title: Strict non-negative price parser
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag returning Decimal('7.50') for '7.5' or rejecting '1.234'. Both are the stated contract: results are normalised to cents, and more than two decimal places is malformed input for this parser rather than something to round silently.
